name: TakeScreenshotNode
label: Take Screenshot
description: Takes a screenshot of all screens, primary screen, or a specific screen and saves it to clipboard or file.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: CaptureMode
fields.label: Capture
fields.description: Specifies which part of the screen to capture.

selectOptions.label: Select screen
selectOptions.description: Captures a specific screen/window by handle.

fields.name: ScreenToCapture
fields.label: Screen to Capture
fields.description: The handle of the screen/window to capture (required if 'Capture' is 'Select screen').

fields.name: SaveMode
fields.label: Save Screenshot To
fields.description: Specifies where to save the screenshot.

selectOptions.label: Clipboard
selectOptions.description: Saves the screenshot to the clipboard.

selectOptions.label: File
selectOptions.description: Saves the screenshot to a file.

fields.name: ImageFilePath
fields.label: Image File Path
fields.description: The path to save the screenshot file (required if 'Save Screenshot To' is 'File').

fields.name: ImageFormat
fields.label: Image Format
fields.description: The format in which to save the screenshot (required if 'Save Screenshot To' is 'File').
